newsitem.title: USA: Clinton hits golf course for 1st time since March.
newsitem.headline: Clinton hits golf course for 1st time since March.

text.p: President Clinton, unwinding after a weekend meeting with world leaders, headed to the Army Navy Country Club near Washington Tuesday to play golf for the first time since injuring his knee in March.

Clinton, an avid golfer kept from his favourite sport by a torn tendon in his right knee, chipped and putted for 45 minutes and then played eight holes of golf at the club in Arlington, Virginia before heading back to the White House.
Asked upon his return to the White House how his knee felt, Clinton flashed reporters a thumbs up sign.
Clinton has been working up to Tuesday's outing for several weeks, putting on a small green on the White House grounds in his off time. But this was his first chance to play golf at a golf course.
